Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot.display: Maize Gray Leaf Spot / Makai ka Khakstari Dhabba (Cercospora zeae-maydis)
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot.prevention: Practice crop rotation with non-host crops. Clear field borders of weed reservoirs that harbor the fungus.
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot.treatment: Apply strobilurin or triazole fungicides at first sign. Remove and destroy infected plant debris after harvest.

Corn___Common_rust.display: Maize Common Rust / Makai ka Zang Rog (Puccinia sorghi)
Corn___Common_rust.prevention: Plant rust-resistant hybrids. Avoid late planting which exposes crops to peak spore season.
Corn___Common_rust.treatment: Apply triazole fungicides if rust appears before grain fill. Most hybrids recover if infection starts late.

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.display: Maize Northern Leaf Blight / Makai ka Pata Jhulsa (Exserohilum turcicum)
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Use resistant hybrids and rotate with soybeans or wheat. Bury crop residue through tillage.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.treatment: Apply strobilurin fungicides immediately between V8 and VT growth stages. Severely blighted fields may need early harvest.

Corn___healthy.prevention: Continue balanced fertilization and monitor for early disease signs weekly.
Corn___healthy.treatment: No intervention needed. Maintain regular monitoring schedule.

Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot.display: Pepper Bacterial Spot / Shimla Mirch ka Bacterial Dhabba (Xanthomonas euvesicatoria)
Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed. Avoid overhead irrigation; water at the base of plants.
Pepper_bell___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper-based bactericides. Remove severely infected leaves to reduce spread. Avoid working with wet plants.

Pepper_bell___healthy.prevention: Continue balanced fertilization and monitor for early disease signs weekly.
Pepper_bell___healthy.treatment: No intervention needed. Maintain regular monitoring schedule.

Potato___Early_blight.display: Potato Early Blight / Aloo ka Ageti Jhulsa (Alternaria solani)
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Mulch soil surface to prevent soil splash. Rotate with non-solanaceous crops for 2-3 years.
Potato___Early_blight.treatment: Spray chlorothalonil or copper fungicides. Remove lower infected leaves to slow upward spread.

Potato___Late_blight.display: Potato Late Blight / Aloo ka Pichheti Jhulsa (Phytophthora infestans)
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Plant certified disease-free seed tubers. Ensure good drainage; avoid overhead irrigation in humid weather.
Potato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply systemic fungicides (metalaxyl + mancozeb) immediately. Destroy infected foliage to protect tubers.

Potato___healthy.prevention: Continue balanced fertilization and monitor for early disease signs weekly.
Potato___healthy.treatment: No intervention needed. Maintain regular monitoring schedule.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.display: Tomato Bacterial Spot / Tamatar ka Bacterial Dhabba (Xanthomonas spp.)
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use drip irrigation instead of overhead watering. Space plants for good air circulation.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.treatment: Apply copper + mancozeb sprays. Prune infected leaves with disinfected tools.

Tomato___Early_blight.display: Tomato Early Blight / Tamatar ka Ageti Jhulsa (Alternaria solani)
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops yearly. Remove plant debris at season end.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Apply chlorothalonil fungicide. Stake plants and mulch to prevent soil contact.

Tomato___Late_blight.display: Tomato Late Blight / Tamatar ka Jhulsa Rog (Phytophthora infestans)
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Water at soil level, never on foliage. Provide wide spacing for airflow.
Tomato___Late_blight.treatment: Apply copper-based fungicide immediately. Remove and destroy infected plants away from the field.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Continue balanced fertilization and monitor for early disease signs weekly.
Tomato___healthy.treatment: No intervention needed. Maintain regular monitoring schedule.
